notes: Written from the statics before scoring anything. A berry must be held against its stem pull (about 2 N, times a 1.5 margin) by two pads: 2*mu*F >= 3 N plus weight, so F of about 3 to 5 N with a soft pad (mu about 0.6 at E of 0.3 MPa). Pressure is force over patch area, so wide pads (20 to 28 mm). The opening must cover the 44 mm largest berry plus a 5 mm camera error, so 50 to 60 mm, but wider catches neighbours. Speed in the middle because both cost and the impact stress rise with it.
